name: Natural Swimmer
text: **Natural Swimmer**: Mordant Spire elves learn to dive and swim at an early age. Elves with this trait gain a +2 racial bonus on Swim checks and can always take 10 on a Swim check, even if distracted or endangered when swimming. This racial trait replaces elven magic and keen senses.
